# Amazon (AMZN) and Marathon Digital (MARA) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 062 | Published 2021-07-11 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-7-11/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/062.json)

Macro mechanisms, mining, and Amazon.

The two central investment forecasts disappoint: MARA lost 71.47% over the stated year, and Amazon remained far below its split-adjusted $250 target at end 2023. MARA's output did grow, but deployment delays activated risks the author explicitly identified and prevented the projected monthly production. Correct technical mechanisms and AWS profit facts should not offset these investment misses in an accuracy rate. Amazon's regulatory caveat is preserved; filing a lawsuit is distinct from executing a breakup. The comparative market-cap forecast needs share-count evidence, not a substitution of share-price returns.

**Coverage:** Read every numbered block and image label, including risk sections and all supporting portfolio theses. Incidental biographies, screenshots without readable values and unrelated routine position lists excluded. Conditions attached to MARA deployment and Amazon regulation are preserved.

- [Post-Covid policy chronology](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/the-federal-reserves-responses-to-the-post-covid-period-of-high-inflation-20240214.html) | Federal Reserve | 2024-02-14 | Verified in the audit

Taper began November 2021 with simultaneous $10 bn Treasury/$5 bn MBS monthly reductions, accelerated in December, ended March 2022; rate liftoff followed in March. Tight labor markets and inflation prompted tightening.
